svg.title: Question 10: how residents get their link. A (recommended): Email link and Copy link in each tenant's sheet on the lease page, plus a one-time Email request links on the Tenants list for launch day. B: one at a time only. C: sent automatically.
svg.text: Question 10: how does each resident get their link?
Launch day, and every new tenant after. The Residents page's "Email me my link" (question 2) covers anyone who loses theirs.

g.text: A. Send from each tenant, plus one send for launch day
Recommended

• From a button on the Tenants list.
• Current tenants only; skips anyone
who already has one.
What Dana gets
Your repair requests link
Hi Dana, from now on, send repairs for

Save it to your home screen.
Emergency? Text us in our group chat.
• "From now on" sets the new rule.
• The button opens their home with
Report a problem on top.
B. One tenant at a time only
• The sheet in A, with no launch-day send.
• Launch day is 51 taps across 31 lease pages.
• Nothing to build for the Tenants list.
C. Sent automatically
• Every current tenant on launch, and each new tenant on
their move-in day, with no button to press.
• Nobody gets forgotten.
• You don't choose the moment, and a wrong email on
file sends it to the wrong person before you notice.

svg.text: Sizes: the sheet and dialog follow the app's pattern: side sheet and centered dialog on laptop and tablet, bottom sheet on phones.
